## Deploy

Deploy from the AWS CloudFormation console or with the AWS CLI command. Both create the endpoint in `us-east-1`; not every instance type is available in every region. The endpoint is ready after 10 to 30 minutes. To deploy from Python, see [Deploy a model](./deploy-a-recipe).

**4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 (ml.g7e.24xlarge)**, $20.72 per hour, 16,384-token context

Validated on 28 Sep 2026 in us-west-2 with vLLM 0.25.0. Prices are us-east-1 on-demand.

Failed checks on this instance: video input.

## Engine settings

Container `huggingface-vllm:0.25-transformers5.10-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04`.

| Environment variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE` | `true` |
| `SM_VLLM_ENFORCE_EAGER` | `true` |
| `SM_VLLM_KV_CACHE_DTYPE` | `fp8` |
| `SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN` | `16384` |
| `SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS` | `8192` |
| `SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS` | `16` |
| `SM_VLLM_MODEL` | `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` |
| `SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER` | `glm47` |
| `SM_VLLM_REVISION` | `eb9eb208eb0d988989d07a6a12d0fdeb5f52574a` |
| `SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME` | `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` |
| `SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE` | `4` |
| `SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER` | `glm47` |
| `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S` | `3600` |

## Send requests

The endpoint serves the OpenAI chat completions API. Any OpenAI client works with a short-lived SageMaker token:

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sagemaker.core.token_generator import generate_token

region, endpoint = "us-east-1", "glm-5-3-flash-g7e-24xlarge"
client = OpenAI(
    base_url=f"https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint}/openai/v1",
    api_key=generate_token(region=region),
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Clean up

Endpoints are billed per hour while they run. Delete the stack when you are done, from the CloudFormation console or with the command below. If you changed the stack name when deploying, use that name instead:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region us-east-1 --stack-name glm-5-3-flash-g7e-24xlarge
```
